guest/rootfs/boot-memory:
#!/bin/sh
# Before Docker restores containers, wait for the configured startup memory
# to be online. Counting memory blocks avoids guessing kernel MemTotal overhead.
set -eu
target_mib="${1:?configured RAM in MiB}"
sysfs="${2:-/sys/devices/system/memory}"
case "$target_mib" in ''|*[!0-9]*) echo 'invalid boot memory target' >&2; exit 1;; esac
block_hex=$(cat "$sysfs/block_size_bytes")
case "$block_hex" in ''|*[!0-9a-fA-F]*) echo 'invalid memory block size' >&2; exit 1;; esac
block_bytes=$((0x$block_hex))
[ "$block_bytes" -gt 0 ] || exit 1
attempt=0
while [ "$attempt" -lt 200 ]; do
    online=$(grep -l '^online$' "$sysfs"/memory[0-9]*/state 2>/dev/null | wc -l)
    online_mib=$((online * block_bytes / 1048576))
    if [ "$online_mib" -ge "$target_mib" ]; then
        echo "INIT boot_memory=ready online_mib=$online_mib waited_ms=$((attempt * 50))"
        exit 0
    fi
    sleep 0.05
    attempt=$((attempt + 1))
done
echo "INIT boot_memory=timeout online_mib=$online_mib target_mib=$target_mib" >&2
exit 1
